title: The Last Week Before the SAT: A Day-by-Day Plan
description:
One week until the SAT? Here's exactly what to do each day, from a full practice test seven days out to the morning of the test.

You'll learn:
• How to take a practice test in Bluebook that actually tells you something
• The 4 labels for every missed question (and what each one tells you to do)
• How to use the free SAT Suite Question Bank for targeted drills
• A quick Desmos warm-up
• Exam setup, your admission ticket, ID rules, and what to pack
• What NOT to do in the last week
• The night before and test morning

Practice questions in this video are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank and the full-length practice tests in Bluebook. Test-day rules come from College Board's test day pages; check them again before your test, since details can change.
